name: War Horse (Armored Stallion Detail)
description: Majestic 3D showcase of an armored samurai war stallion. A muscular pitch-black war horse with fiery crimson eyes, adorned with black lacquer leather barding armor plates, vibrant crimson silk harness cords, and golden clan crest chanfron.
prompt: Masterwork 3D detailed concept art of a magnificent armored Japanese samurai war horse. A powerful muscular pitch-black stallion with fiery red eyes, wearing dark black lacquer leather barding armor laced with thick vibrant crimson red (#FF2035) braided silk cords, and a gold clan crest forehead chanfron plate.
